title: Tokenized Stocks Report With Token Terminal: Q3 2026
window: 90-day window; DeFi and DEX as of October 4
description: Q3 tokenized stock market cap, holders, DeFi TVL and DEX trading volume.

blocks.text: This is the Q3 2026 tokenized stocks edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks how tokenized stocks moved over the third quarter by asset, issuer and chain, covering market cap, holders, Defi TVL and DEX trading volume.

parts.text: This is the Q3 2026 tokenized stocks edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks how tokenized stocks moved over the third quarter by asset, issuer and chain, covering market cap, holders, Defi TVL and DEX trading volume.

blocks.text: All figures (apart from Defi TVL & DEX trading, they are both taken as of October 4th) are taken from Token Terminal as of October 1, 2026. Growth figures cover the 90-day window from July 3 to October 1. No third-party data has been added, and no figures have been adjusted or estimated.

parts.text: All figures (apart from Defi TVL & DEX trading, they are both taken as of October 4th) are taken from Token Terminal as of October 1, 2026. blocks.text: Market cap refers to circulating asset market cap as reported by Token Terminal. Holders refers to addresses holding a non-zero balance, summed across assets without removing duplicates. DEX trading volume refers to volume traded on decentralized exchanges over the 90-day window.

blocks.text: Overview

parts.text: Overview

blocks.text: Tokenized stock market cap stood at $3.6 billion on October 1, spread across 17 chains. Holder addresses totalled 4.7 million, across 5,251 assets and 25 issuers. DEX trading volume over the 90 days was around $40 billion.

parts.text: Tokenized stock market cap stood at $3.6 billion on October 1, spread across 17 chains. Holder addresses totalled 4.7 million, across 5,251 assets and 25 issuers. DEX trading volume over the 90 days was around $40 billion.

blocks.text: Growth was concentrated in a few issuers and chains. Binance bStocks and xStocks added $949.5 million in market cap between them. Robinhood and Binance bStocks added about 2.7 million holder addresses between them. BNB Chain led all three measures by chain: market cap, holders and DEX trading volume.

parts.text: Growth by asset

blocks.text: Securitize's SECZ added $106.9 million over 90 days, narrowly ahead of CRCLb at $106.8 million. MSTRb (+$79.9 million), MSTRx (+$74.4 million) and STRCon (+$66.8 million) followed. blocks.text: The following figures were taken on October 4 and cover the 90 days to that date, over which tokenized stock DEX volume was $42.3 billion. parts.text: DeFi TVL

blocks.text: Tokenized stock DeFi TVL stood at $257.5 million on October 4, across 17 venues. Solana hosted 36.3% of it and Robinhood Chain 28.5%, giving the two chains 64.8% between them. parts.text: Conclusion

blocks.text: Tokenized stocks reached $3.6 billion in market cap and 4.7 million holder addresses. Market cap growth was led by Binance bStocks and xStocks, which added $949.5 million between them, and by BNB Chain, which added $552.9 million.

blocks.text: Holder growth was led by Robinhood and Binance bStocks, and by BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain and Solana. Most of the sector's holder addresses were added during the quarter.
